description: This file defines the ConsoleWatcherListener class for the Goteo project. It contains event listener methods that respond to project publishing, ending, activation, and watch events, performing actions such as logging, sending notifications, and creating feeds.

classes.name: ConsoleWatcherListener
classes.description: An event listener class that handles project-related events such as publishing, ending, activation, and monitoring, primarily for logging, notifications, and feed updates.

methods.name: logFeedEntry
methods.description: Logs a feed entry, warning if the feed is a duplicate, or notices if populated.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends notifications to project owners or consultants, ensuring no duplicate events are created.

methods.name: onProjectPublish
methods.description: Handles actions when a project is published, including logging and creating feed entries.

methods.name: onProjectEnding
methods.description: Handles actions when a project is ending, such as generating a feed notification.

methods.name: onProjectActive
methods.description: Sends advice or reminders to project owners based on campaign progress and conditions.

methods.name: onProjectWatch
methods.description: Sends reminders or notifications for projects requiring attention, including contract and reward status.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of event names and corresponding handler methods for subscribing to project events.
